## About HumanPlus

HumanPlus builds scalable **Life Capture infrastructure for embodied intelligence**.

Our motion-capture garments, lightweight head-mounted devices, and proprietary algorithms capture egocentric vision, full-body motion, and real-world human interaction without disrupting natural work.

By synchronizing, reconstructing, and processing these multimodal signals for model training, we turn everyday work and life into real-world data that robots can understand and learn from.
